qualification.details: Special Educator for Behavioural Therapy: Diploma / Bachelors / Master's degree in Special Education (D.Ed / B.Ed/M.Ed) from a UGC-recognized university with live RCI Registration. RMNCH Counsellor: Masters / Bachelors Degree in Social Work / Public Administration / Psychology / Sociology / Home Science / Hospital & Health Management with 1-2 years experience. Yoga and Naturopathy Doctor: BNYS or MD (Y&N). Ayurveda Doctor: BAMS or MD (A). Consultant (Yoga and Naturopathy): BNYS or MD (Y&N). Attender (MPW) (Yoga and Naturopathy): 8th Pass / Must Read and Write Skills in Tamil. Siddha Doctor (PG Qualification): MD (Siddha). Yoga Professional: BNYS. Siddha - Pharmacist: Diploma in integrate Pharmacist (Certificates issued by Govt of Tamil Nadu only). Siddha - Therapeutic Assistant (Female & Male): Diploma Nursing Therapy (Certificates issued by Government of Tamil Nadu Only). Data Assistant - Siddha: Graduation in Computer Application / IT / Business Administration / B.Tech (C.S) or (IT) / BCA / BBA / B.Sc-IT with 1 year experience and typing speed English 30 WPM, Tamil 25 WPM. Laboratory Technician Gr-3: +2 with Biology and Diploma in Medical Lab Technology (DMLT) 2 years course approved by Directorate of Medical Education.

how_to_apply: Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://erode.nic.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.

Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 21-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DHS Erode Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the various contractual posts at District Health Society Erode is 21 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the DHS Erode Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 19 vacancies announced for various contractual positions within the District Health Society Erode.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the DHS Erode Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum qualification required for the Attender post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification for the Attender (MPW) (Yoga and Naturopathy) post is an 8th Pass, along with the ability to read and write in Tamil.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the DHS Erode Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category of candidates applying for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary range for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The salary for the various contractual posts ranges from Rs. 10,000 to Rs. 60,000 per month, depending on the specific position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for the Laboratory Technician Gr-3 post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Laboratory Technician Gr-3 post is below 30 years.

faq.question: Q8. What are the selection methods for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the DHS Erode Recruitment 2026 will involve an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the District Health Society Erode, which is https://erode.nic.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the highest salary offered in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The highest salary offered in this recruitment is Rs. 60,000 per month for the Siddha Doctor (PG Qualification) post.
